name: fleet
description: Vehicles and drivers, trips from odometer readings, fuel logs and consumption, maintenance due by distance or time, and a cost report.
author: test2 benchmark author (language model, written without reading the reviewer)

issues.description: A service is due when the distance limit OR the time limit is reached (whichever comes first), but the code requires both, so rules with a single limit never fall due and a vehicle that passed one limit is not flagged.
FuelLog() without arguments stores the shared default list, so every log created that way sees the fill-ups added to the others.
issues.fix_hint: Default to None and create a new list inside __init__.

issues.description: The docstring says the liters of the first full-tank fill-up are not counted, but the slice starts at that fill-up, overstating consumption.
The uploaded file name is joined to the storage folder unchecked, so a name with '..' writes the receipt anywhere on disk.
issues.fix_hint: Reject names whose resolved path leaves root/receipts/<entry_id> (or keep only the base name).

issues.description: The license validity rule lives in Driver.can_drive, but TripLog.record re-implements the comparison itself, so the two can drift apart.
One 60-line function gathers the numbers, computes per-vehicle and fleet totals, sorts and formats the table; the per-km formatting and the line formatting are written twice.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: MD5 is only a duplicate-upload fingerprint, explicitly marked not for security.
The broad except logs the failure and re-raises, so no error is swallowed.
